_note: All combat numbers. dmg = damage per hit, rate = hits per second. Armour halves every hit per point unless the attacker pierces. multi = enemies hit per shot (only vs one-hit kills); splash = enemies each shot hits (never more than the gang holds). target toughest = shoots the toughest gang in range (bosses first) instead of the nearest; one_per_shot = a shot never kills more than the one enemy it hits (damage capped at that enemy's hp). unlock = first level where the rank/enemy appears (tools/gen_levels.py reads it). shield = riot-shield hp per unit, soaked before any kill (piercing fire passes). cols/row_gap = gang formation. stop_at = holds that distance and attacks (first_shot s after stopping, then every shoot_every / throw_every s); shoot_range = attacks while still walking (bosses). Gunfire: every shoot_every s each living shooter kills shot_dmg troops. Molotov: every throw_every s the group lobs a firebomb into the lane the squad is in; it lands flight s later and burns `burn` troops per living thrower if the squad is still in that lane. Sniper foe: every shoot_every s, after an `aim` s laser, each living sniper kills shot_dmg. SHIELD blocks all ranged hits and melee. world: lane_width = metres between lane centres; formation_half_width caps how wide the squad's formation gets (spec v2 §4: about one lane wide at full size, so a full squad's outer figures can brush an obstacle in the next lane; steering matters); formation_figures = most figures a formation has (each carries total/figures troops); figure_radius for obstacle overlap; red_gate_clear_s = a red gate's tick never needs more than this many seconds of the squad's fire to reach 0; gang_priority_m = a gang whose front is within this many metres takes the fire before any nearer gate or obstacle. squad_cap = the most troops a squad can hold, per district (1-5; spec v2 section 12.4); Police Station barracks add a percentage of it (upgrades.capacity = percent). Every count is an exact 64-bit integer; only the display shortens (NumFormat). gang_figures = most figures a gang is drawn with: a gang of n stands in figures of per = ceil(n / gang_figures) people, a row of cols figures is cols x per people, so a huge gang is never more than gang_figures / cols rows deep. melee_cap_pct = the crowd clash (spec v2.1 section 1.4, owner 2026-11-13): once a gang's living front reaches the squad, every melee_tick at most melee_cap_pct % of the squad it met (in troops) strikes from its front row (at least one enemy, never more than the row), each enemy taking `power` troops and falling; the rest of the row waits for the next tick, so both numbers fall together over a few seconds (0 = the whole row at once). SHIELD breaks the whole row with no loss. A boss swings with his own fists.

hero._note: Tap-to-fire (spec v2 section 2): the hero's knife (and a held PISTOL/SMG) fires at lerp(auto_rate, 1, heat) of its rate. Each tap adds per_tap heat (max 1); heat holds for hold_s after a tap, then drains to 0 over decay_s. Followers always fire at full rate. The level's mean heat is the payout's tap term (economy.json payout.heat: up to +10 %, spec v2.1 section 3.1).

input._note: Tap vs swipe (src/core/touch_classifier.gd). A touch that stays within tap_max_px (times the screen scale) and lifts within tap_max_s is a tap: it powers the hero and never steers. Taps count only in the tap zone, from zone_top of the screen height down. Anything that moves further steers. A shield or bomb press within power_guard_s of a fire tap that landed next to that button is ignored (a thumb tapping fast that slid onto it); a press with the other thumb still works.

_attack_note: Spec v2.1 section 1.2: the specials (enemies with `attack`) act before they die. From the moment their front is within attack.start_m (beyond the squad's fire_range) they mark the squad's lane (a `telegraph`: snipe = laser, grenade and firebomb = lane mark); first_shot s after that the first, then every shoot_every (snipers, grenadiers) or throw_every (molotovs) s. Each lands attack.warn_s later on the lane it marked: the squad is hit only if it still stands in that lane then (its real position), and the shield blocks it. A landed attack costs count x shot_dmg (or x burn) troops, but never more than cap_pct % of the squad right now (at least 1). They keep walking to stop_at; once stopped, the rows behind walk up as the front rows fall, so the living front stays at stop_at (inside the squad's reach). A level's fire_k (config/levels, fitted by tests/tune.gd calibrate=1 within 0.5-2) makes its gangs after the first fire fire_k x the return-fire shots per second and attack min(fire_k, telegraph.fire_k_max) x as often (the opening volley and bosses keep their numbers; a level's boss_k, 0.5-1.5, scales its boss's or lieutenant's gun_pct and barrage_pct, in per mille). telegraph: at most max_in_air marks in the air at once and at least min_gap_s between two marks; an attack that is due waits for a free one. aim: true marks a laser sniper (Codex).

return_fire._note: Spec v2.1 section 1.1 (v2 section 12.2): gangs with guns fire at the squad while their front is within `range` metres (more than fire_range: they outrange the squad) and not in melee. On first entering range a gang fires `open` shots at once (the opening volley); after that its shooters fire rate shots/s each. Shooters per gang = share % of it (rounded up) but at most max_shooters[district - 1]. Each hit takes one visible figure: max(1, ceil(squad / figures_shown)) troops, lowest rank first, and one volley (one event) takes at most volley_cap_pct % of the squad (at least one hit). The hero falls last: while the squad never had a follower this level (a hero-alone opening) return fire never takes him; once followers joined he falls when he is the only one left. SHIELD blocks it, a bomb kills shooters. Per enemy: return_fire = {rate, share, optional range and from_district}; gangs fire back from from_district on (an enemy's own from_district overrides it; gunmen: 1).

boss._note: Spec v2.1 section 1.3, the district boss (enemies.boss without `lieutenant`). HP: hp_secs[district - 1] s of the expected squad's damage per second at that level (tools/gen_levels.py; calibration.json boss_dps, measured by Autopilot.boss_dps), never scaled by the calibration k x kf; he halts the street (world.boss_halt) at least halt_min_s on the expected route. Barrage: barrage_first s after he halts, then every barrage_every s, he marks the squad's lane (telegraph `barrage`); warn_s later it lands there and takes barrage_pct[district - 1] % of the squad (at least 1); changing lane dodges it, the shield blocks it. His gun (every enemies.boss.shoot_every s within shoot_range) takes gun_pct % of the squad per shot (at least 1; never the hero of a squad that never had followers). barrage_every 0 = no barrage.

lieutenant._note: Spec v2.1 section 1.3: the mini-boss of slot 5 (L5, 15, 25, 35, 45; tools/gen_levels.py lieutenant_wave). A boss group with "lieutenant": true: he fights like the boss (halt, bar, gun, barrage `lt_barrage`) with these numbers, is drawn `scale` x a thug with his own tint and a smaller bar, and liberates nothing.

obstacles._note: Defaults; a level event may override any key. width = footprint across the road (m): an obstacle only hits the troops whose formation slots overlap it, up to its number (fall/dmg or the % forms), so steering half past it saves half the squad. pothole: unshootable, falling in costs `fall` troops (or `fall_pct` % of the squad); the hero always hops over, so it never ends the level. barricade: shoot its hp away or crash into it (dmg troops, or dmg_pct % of the squad) and lose the next gate in that lane. car: shoot it away or crash (dmg or dmg_pct). barrel: shoot it to arm it; it blows up when the next gang's front reaches it, killing up to `kill` gang members in total (nearest gang first). A lit barrel that reaches the squad first goes off on it: the troops on its footprint fall, up to armed_pct % of its dmg.

powers._note: Spec v2 section 12.5: the bomb is thrown at any moment of a level. The hero winds up for `windup` s (the throw clip until the bomb leaves his hand), then it flies `flight` s down the squad's lane and lands on the nearest thing in that lane within `reach` m at landing (a gang's front, a barricade, car or barrel the squad will not reach first; never a pothole or a gate), else on the road at reach. One bomb in the air at a time, and none in the last metres before the stash when no gang is left. On landing (the sim applies it then, exact): every gang whose front is within `radius` m loses kill_pct % (at least min_kill, never more than it has) and half its riot shields; a gang member with hp >= big_hp takes big_dmg instead, and a boss loses big_pct % of its full health (at least big_dmg); barricades and cars within `radius` m are destroyed, barrels within it go off. A gang it lands on holds its fire for silence_s s (no return fire, no new marks; spec v2.1 section 1.1: the bomb answers return fire).

boosters._note: Pre-level tokens handed to LevelSim in the upgrades dict: headstart = constables per token; shield/bomb tokens add charges like the garage does.

revive._note: Once per level after a loss (rewarded ad): squad back to pct % of its peak, gangs within push metres are shoved back to push, and a shield (s) covers the restart; it outlasts one molotov throw cycle (throw_every + flight) so a firebomb already on its way cannot undo the revive.

stars._note: Fallback star thresholds (percent of peak squad left at the finish) when a level has none.
